node.statement: Let C_co,e_co be the universal constants from lem-compcb-rectangular-product and let e_cmp be the universal threshold from lem-compcb-amplified-compression. Set C_rc=C_co and e_rc=min(e_co,e_cmp), and fix arbitrary data e=delta+epsilon<=e_rc, P,Q,A,n,X,Y satisfying node 1. It remains to prove the displayed estimate for these fixed data.
